import random
import sys

seed = int(sys.stdin.readline())
rng = random.Random(seed)
n = rng.randint(1, 6)
m = rng.randint(1, 6)
k = rng.randint(0, 3)
p = rng.choice([0.2, 0.4, 0.6])
rows = []
for r in range(n):
    rows.append(''.join('1' if rng.random() < p else '0' for _ in range(m)))
rows[0] = '0' + rows[0][1:]
rows[n - 1] = rows[n - 1][:m - 1] + '0'
print(n, m, k)
print('\n'.join(rows))
